the resulting supernatant was subjected to incubation with streptavidin-conjugated beads (GE Healthcare) at 4 °C for 2 h with gentle rocking. Following three washes with ice-cold NETN buffer, the immunocomplexes were eluted with biotin (1 mg ml−1, Sigma) at 4 °C for 1 h. The elutes were further incubated with S-protein beads (EMD Millipore) at 4 °C for 2 h with gentle rocking. The proteins bound to S-protein beads underwent three washes with ice-cold NETN buffer, were resolved on SDS–PAGE, and then subjected to analysis by mass spectrometry.
